word: yelw thelo or eyelw ethelo in certain tenses yelew theleo and eyelew etheleo which are otherwise obsolete
etymology: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of 138
avSummary: will/would 159, will/would have 16, desire 13, desirous 3, list 3, to will 2, misc 4
definition:
1) to will, have in mind, intend
    1a) to be resolved or determined, to purpose
    1b) to desire, to wish
    1c) to love
        1c1) to like to do a thing, be fond of doing
    1d) to take delight in, have pleasure

 Sinonim   : Lihat Definisi 5915
